description: Arr: sixteen knobs sent out as one polyphonic cable, with a choice of quantizing each knob to a scale, an octave or a fraction

params.text: Sets the voltage of that channel, within the range chosen on the menu and snapped to the grid chosen there

outputs.text: The knob values after every expander in the chain has had its turn, one to a channel, all of them snapped to the chosen grid

notes: values arriving from an input expander are snapped the same way the knobs are
under Steps a knob moves in sixteenths of ten volts and reads as a whole number, so typing 5 gives 3.125V and the hover text reads #5
menu: Voltage Range — sets the range every knob covers: 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-1V, +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V or +/-1V
Snap to — chooses what the knobs snap to: None, Octave (1V), Steps, a scale, or a fraction
Root note — sets the root the chosen scale is built on
Add Expander — places a ReX, InX or OutX expander on the correct side of this module
